description: Proprietor Mr. Subhash started business with cash capital ₹5,00,000.
narration: Being initial cash capital introduced by proprietor into business.
explanation: Cash asset increases by ₹5,00,000 (Debit Cash). Owner's capital equity increases by ₹5,00,000 (Credit Capital).

description: Opened current bank account with State Bank of India by depositing cash ₹3,00,000.
narration: Being cash deposited to open current bank account with SBI (F4 Contra).
explanation: Bank asset increases (Debit SBI Bank). Cash asset decreases (Credit Cash). Recorded in F4 Contra Voucher.

description: Purchased office furniture for ₹45,000 paying by SBI cheque.
narration: Being office furniture purchased for business use via cheque.
explanation: Furniture fixed asset increases (Debit Furniture). Bank liquid asset decreases (Credit SBI Bank).

description: Purchased trading goods for cash ₹60,000.
narration: Being goods purchased for cash for resale.
explanation: Purchase expense increases (Debit Purchase). Cash asset decreases (Credit Cash).

description: Purchased raw goods on credit from M/s Bengal Chemicals for ₹1,20,000.
narration: Being goods purchased on credit from M/s Bengal Chemicals vide Bill No BC-401.
explanation: Purchase cost increases (Debit Purchase). Vendor creditor liability increases (Credit Bengal Chemicals).

description: Paid freight inward cash ₹2,500 on raw goods purchased.
narration: Being transportation freight paid for bringing goods to store.
explanation: Direct freight expense increases (Debit Freight Inward). Cash asset decreases (Credit Cash).

description: Sold goods for cash ₹85,000.
narration: Being trading goods sold for cash.
explanation: Cash asset increases (Debit Cash). Sales revenue income increases (Credit Sales).

description: Sold goods on credit to M/s Rahul Enterprise for ₹1,50,000.
classification: Rahul Enterprise (Sundry Debtor Asset +), Sales (Revenue Income +)
narration: Being goods sold on credit to M/s Rahul Enterprise vide Invoice No INV-001.
explanation: Debtor customer asset increases (Debit Rahul Enterprise). Sales revenue increases (Credit Sales).

description: Returned defective goods worth ₹10,000 to M/s Bengal Chemicals.
classification: Bengal Chemicals (Creditor Liability -), Purchase Return (Expense Reduction -)
narration: Being defective goods returned to vendor Bengal Chemicals vide Debit Note No DN-01.
explanation: Vendor liability decreases (Debit Bengal Chemicals). Purchase return reduces cost (Credit Purchase Return).

description: M/s Rahul Enterprise returned damaged goods worth ₹5,000.
classification: Sales Return (Revenue Reduction -), Rahul Enterprise (Debtor Asset -)
narration: Being damaged goods returned by customer Rahul Enterprise vide Credit Note No CN-01.
explanation: Sales return reduces net sales (Debit Sales Return). Debtor customer asset decreases (Credit Rahul Enterprise).

description: Paid ₹1,00,000 to M/s Bengal Chemicals by SBI net banking in full settlement after ₹10,000 discount.
classification: Bengal Chemicals (Liability - ₹1,10,000), SBI Bank (Asset - ₹1,00,000), Discount Received (Income + ₹10,000)
narration: Being net payment made to Bengal Chemicals in full settlement of bill after cash discount.
explanation: Vendor debt of ₹1,10,000 cleared (Debit Bengal Chemicals). Bank decreases by ₹1,00,000. Discount gain earned ₹10,000 (Credit Discount Received).

description: Received ₹1,40,000 cheque from M/s Rahul Enterprise after allowing ₹5,000 cash discount.
classification: SBI Bank (Asset + ₹1,40,000), Discount Allowed (Expense + ₹5,000), Rahul Enterprise (Debtor Asset - ₹1,45,000)
narration: Being cheque received from Rahul Enterprise in settlement after cash discount.
explanation: Bank asset increases by ₹1,40,000. Discount allowed expense debited ₹5,000. Customer debtor balance cleared ₹1,45,000.

description: Paid shop rent ₹18,000 and electricity ₹6,000 cash.
narration: Being shop rent and electricity bill paid in cash (Compound Payment).
explanation: Compound entry debiting Rent (₹18,000) and Electricity (₹6,000), crediting Cash (₹24,000).

description: Paid staff salary ₹35,000 by SBI bank transfer.
narration: Being monthly staff salaries paid via bank transfer for April 2026.
explanation: Salary expense increases (Debit Salary). Bank asset decreases (Credit SBI Bank).

description: Proprietor Mr. Subhash withdrew ₹12,000 cash from business for personal family house expenses.
narration: Being cash withdrawn by proprietor for personal household expenses.
explanation: Drawings reduces capital equity (Debit Drawings). Cash asset decreases (Credit Cash).

description: Proprietor took goods costing ₹4,000 for personal domestic use.
narration: Being goods taken by owner at cost price for personal family consumption.
explanation: Goods taken for personal use reduce Purchase stock cost (Credit Purchase A/c) at cost price.

description: Distributed goods costing ₹3,000 as free samples for market promotion.
narration: Being goods distributed as free samples for business promotion.
explanation: Sample distribution is a promotional marketing expense (Debit Advertisement) reducing Purchase cost (Credit Purchase).

description: Paid annual trade insurance premium ₹12,000 by cheque.
narration: Being annual shop insurance premium paid via SBI cheque.
explanation: Insurance expense debited (Debit Insurance Premium). Bank asset credited (Credit SBI Bank).

description: Purchased office computer printer for ₹22,000 cash.
narration: Being office computer printer purchased for business admin use.
explanation: Fixed asset increases (Debit Computer & Printer). Cash asset decreases (Credit Cash).

description: Received ₹8,000 cash as commission income.
narration: Being agency commission received in cash.
explanation: Cash asset increases (Debit Cash). Indirect income increases (Credit Commission Received).

description: Bank debited ₹450 as quarterly SMS & internet banking service charges.
narration: Being bank charges debited by SBI for online banking service.
explanation: Operating expense debited (Debit Bank Charges). Bank balance reduced (Credit SBI Bank).

description: Customer 'Suresh Kumar' became insolvent; his total debt of ₹15,000 written off as Bad Debt.
classification: Bad Debts (Operating Loss +), Suresh Kumar (Debtor Asset -)
narration: Being unrecoverable debtor balance written off as Bad Debt (F7 Journal).
explanation: Uncollectible debt is an operating loss (Debit Bad Debts). Customer debtor balance cleared (Credit Suresh Kumar).

description: Previously written-off bad debtor Suresh Kumar surprisingly paid ₹6,000 in cash.
narration: Being cash recovered from written-off customer Suresh Kumar.
explanation: Cash asset increases (Debit Cash). Non-operating gain credited (Credit Bad Debts Recovered).

description: Depreciation of ₹4,500 charged on office furniture.
narration: Being annual depreciation charged on office furniture (F7 Journal).
explanation: Non-cash operating expense debited (Debit Depreciation). Fixed asset book value reduced (Credit Furniture).

description: Accrued interest of ₹2,500 on bank fixed deposit earned but not yet received.
classification: Accrued Interest (Current Asset +), Interest Income (Revenue Income +)
narration: Being accrued interest income recognized on bank FD at month-end.
explanation: Accrual concept creates current receivable asset (Debit Accrued Interest) and recognizes income (Credit Interest Income).
